notes.title: Recent Updates
notes.content:
It's been a while since we've posted any updates so here are some recent developments in GonzoVR:


 There are avatars in the studio broadcasts now! There are two speaker slots where you can step up and engage in discussion as a cute little avatar. There's also a spot where only you can see your avatar so you can have fun and play around with it if you're not ready to join the conversation.
 We've improved the quality of the stream significantly with some excellent denoising solutions.
 We've made discussions easier to follow by decreasing the volume of viewer's voices unless they're in a speaker slot where they can be heard at a normal volume. This helps prevent people from speaking over each other and also gives some visual representation of the people talking.


Don't forget to join our discord to stay updated and catch the studio broadcast every night at 6 pm PST!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1/2/19
notes.content:
Latest patch going up now:
1) You can now watch past broadcasts. Currently we have the Rob from Cyanide and Happiness, Abe Groening, and the cooking broadcast we did
2) Minor optimizations to the audio decoder
3) Better handling of the microphone, so hopefully the rare issue where your mic remains unconnected will be fixed
4) People with lower end GPUs and people on high pings get a smaller resolution pano which means higher frame rate and faster room joins

Also, the past broadcasts had some issues with the compression, so they don't look as crisp or as bright as they ought to. Not certain if we'll fix this right now

notes.title: Recent Patch Updates 12/13/18
notes.content:
Here is a rundown of some recent patches:

-Minor optimizations to the audio encoder
-- Receives messages from the broadcaster app
-- Fixes with typing long messages and their display
-- Fixed rare null reference
-Fixed the rare issue where sometimes one eye would be black and rotated
-Lobby images and some marker images are now cached to your local hard drive, so they will load much faster.
-The desktop streaming marker will show the GVR logo if no one is currently streaming, and I put in a fairly sizeable performance improvement regarding CPU usage

notes.title: Patch Updates 10/21/18
notes.content:
Here is a rundown of recent patches:
-Fixed an issue where sometimes parts of the UI disappeared
-Updated some streaming libraries
-Added (maybe-hopefully) support for streaming a 2D desktop view into an AR marker
-Set up support for a spectator camera in the living room so you can either drive the car or, occasionally, watch from a different perspective that doesn't move
-Set up a shared audio channel so people in the car and spectator camera can talk to each other
